content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against a company for violating their rights. The Chief Commissioner delegates his powers relating to administrative matters of the Central Authority to a Commissioner.
content.outcome: The Commissioner, as delegated by the Chief Commissioner, exercises the powers of general superintendence, direction and control in respect of all administrative matters of the Central Authority.
